lines.text: The LORD tells Jeremiah not to pray for the people, who make cakes for the Queen of Heaven.
When the LORD brought their fathers out of Babylon, He commanded them to obey Him, but they did not listen.
The LORD sent His servants the prophets again and again, yet the people stiffened their necks and did more evil.
The people built the high places of Topheth in Ben-hinnom, which will be called the Valley of Achor.
The bones of the kings, officials, priests, prophets and people will be removed from their graves and not buried again.
